sections.studentIdPasswordNote: Kani waa erayga sirta ah ee ugu horreeya ardayga (lambariisa ardaynimada). Ma aha mid la arki karo marka uu ardaygu eray cusub dejiyo.

sections.generatedPasswordNote: Eray sir ah oo cusub ayaa la soo saaray. Qofka waxaa la weydiisanayaa inuu beddelo markuu soo galo.
sections.revealUnavailableHint: Fur akoonka adigoo isticmaalaya “Wax ka beddel”, kadibna isticmaal “Dib u deji erayga sirta ah” si aad u soo saarto mid kumeel gaar ah. Marka uu isagu dejiyo eraygiisa, mar kale ma aha mid la arki karo.
sections.revealResetHint: Soo saar eray sir ah oo cusub si aad u siiso fursad cusub oo soo galitaan. Waa la arki karaa halkan ilaa uu isagu dejiyo midkiisa.
